items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: And she was with me for quite awhile and she married Marsalis Green, the trumpet player with me then.

ctx.x: DeLores Brown. She did quite a few recordings for me. I got DeLores Brown, she was singing along with Duke along with Ivie Anderson. Duke had two vocalists. They were at Loew's State and I went down to catch Duke. And, I saw them both. I went backstage, this is after hours. I said Duke, you don't need two vocalists. I said I like DeLores there. He said go talk to her if you want her.
And she was with me for quite awhile and she married Marsalis Green, the trumpet player with me then.
Yeah. Anybody else that we haven't thought of that functioned as vocalist at that time?
